title: The hit card: B, the khaki man-target board, at three window sizes and three ranges
about: Your scores of 2026-11-08: A 10, B ★ 99, C 0, "Second set is perfect, keep all three to represent varying ranges." B is now the hit card at every window size, and A and C are gone from the game. One string's marks on a turner: a Pair to the chest, a third round high, a fourth missed. Left, what the marine could tell during the string (belief): a hollow amber ring where his sight was at each break, filled when he saw it strike, numbered. Right, the debrief (truth): the holes in ink where they went, the calls faint under them, the coach's line. Each in the hit card's box at 1024 × 768 (--ui 0.85: the card drawn at 170 px, its whole pixels), 1600 × 900 (--ui 1.25) and 1920 × 1080 (--ui 1.5), at whole pixels where they fit. "Keep all three to represent varying ranges" is read (my reading, to confirm) as one board seen at three ranges: the last view is the debrief's card at 7, 20 and 50 m, the board's figure at 96, 80 and 64 px a metre (up to 10 m, up to 25 m, beyond), a farther board lower on longer stakes, the marks at their own sizes. If you meant the three looks, A and C come back with a revert.
